headline: Binance pauses withdrawals in suspected hack

scenes.vo: Binance, the biggest crypto exchange, has paused withdrawals while it investigates a suspected hack. Here's what changed.
This afternoon, billions of dollars in crypto moved out of Binance hot wallets to new addresses. Binance says it is investigating a potential security issue, and says user funds are safe.
Here's why traders are watching it. Tether and Circle say they froze more than two billion dollars in stablecoins tied to the transfers, which could limit any damage.
The catch. Binance has not confirmed a hack or a loss figure. Estimates run from under two billion to almost six billion. B N B fell about seven percent.
Here's what happens next. Watch for Binance's official update, a confirmed loss figure, and when withdrawals reopen.
